project_type: Nx monorepo with Angular frontend, Lambda API, CDK infrastructure
build_system: pnpm + Nx. Use `pnpm nx build infra` to build the infra app. Use `pnpm nx run-many -t build` for all apps. CDK app entry point uses ts-node directly.
test_framework: No test runner currently configured. Testing steering recommends Vitest but it is not installed.
build_command: export PATH="/root/.local/share/mise/installs/node/26.5.0/bin:$PATH" && cd /projects/sandbox/recipe-manager && pnpm nx run-many -t build lint
test_command: No test command available - project has no test runner configured
verification_instructions: 1. Run `pnpm nx run-many -t build lint` to verify all apps build and lint passes. 2. Verify the workflow YAML is valid syntax. 3. CDK synth cannot fully run without Angular build output (dist/apps/web/browser), so validate infra compilation via `pnpm nx build infra`.
environment_constraints: Node.js 26.5.0 installed via mise. pnpm 10.14.0 installed globally. No AWS credentials available (cannot run actual CDK deploy). CDK synth fails without Angular dist output but infra TypeScript compilation works.
contribution_requirements: PR titles must follow semantic PR format (e.g., 'feat: ...'). Always run full build and lint before submitting. See .kiro/steering/conventions.md.
key_patterns: CDK stack in apps/infra/src/stacks/recipe-manager-stack.ts. PR preview uses context values (prNumber, prUrl, mainUserPoolId, mainUserPoolClientId). deploy-pr.yml workflow handles PR deployments. DynamoDB table outputs are available as CloudFormation stack outputs. Table uses userId (partition) + id (sort key). DynamoDB table resource logical ID in the stack is 'RecipesTable'.
directory_structure: apps/api/ - Lambda handler, apps/infra/ - CDK infrastructure, apps/web/ - Angular frontend, libs/shared/ - shared types, .github/workflows/ - CI/CD workflows, scripts/ - utility scripts
